input.title: FIN-2013-G001
input.abstract: On March 18, 2013, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network issued interpretive guidance clarifying the applicability of the regulations implementing the Bank Secrecy Act to persons creating, obtaining, distributing, exchanging, accepting, or transmitting virtual currencies such as Bitcoin. The guidance explains only how FinCEN characterizes certain activities involving virtual currencies under the Bank Secrecy Act and FinCEN regulations. Under FinCEN's rules a Bitcoin miner may be an administrator. This guidance clarified that Bitcoin exchanges are considered money transmitters and are required to obtain all proper licenses to conduct business in the United States. This registration and licensing process includes the federal registration as a money service business.
input.source: DIGITAL CURRENCY CHALLENGE: SHAPING ONLINE PAYMENT SYSTEMS THROUGH US FINANCIAL REGULATIONS

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
